then this stone, which I have set up for a pillar, will be God’s house. Of all that you will give me I will surely give…
Moses and the elders of Israel commanded the people, saying, “Keep all the commandment which I command you today.
Then Samuel took a stone, and set it between Mizpah and Shen, and called its name Ebenezer, saying, “Yahweh helped us…
Praise Yahweh, my soul, and don’t forget all his benefits,
Yahweh is in his holy temple. Yahweh is on his throne in heaven. His eyes observe. His eyes examine the children of men.
He answered them, “I tell you that if these were silent, the stones would cry out.”
The children of Israel did as Joshua commanded, and took up twelve stones out of the middle of the Jordan, as Yahweh…
The people came up out of the Jordan on the tenth day of the first month, and encamped in Gilgal, on the east border of…
Joshua set up those twelve stones, which they took out of the Jordan, in Gilgal.

translations.web: and command them, saying, ‘Take from out of the middle of the Jordan, out of the place where the priests’ feet stood firm, twelve stones, carry them over with you, and lay them down in the place where you’ll camp tonight.’ ”
translations.bsb: and command them: ‘Take up for yourselves twelve stones from the middle of the Jordan where the priests were standing, carry them with you, and set them down in the place where you spend the night.’”
translations.kjv: And command ye them, saying, Take you hence out of the midst of Jordan, out of the place where the priests' feet stood firm, twelve stones, and ye shall carry them over with you, and leave them in the lodging place, where ye shall lodge this night.
translations.asv: and command ye them, saying, Take you hence out of the midst of the Jordan, out of the place where the priests' feet stood firm, twelve stones, and carry them over with you, and lay them down in the lodging-place, where ye shall lodge this night.
